Yes, but only with `--dry-run`.

A project memory says that in staging, `EXPORT_BUCKET` points at the **production** bucket. A real export from staging would write to prod data. The script still has the flag (`scripts/export.py:8`), so the safe command is:

```
python scripts/export.py <env> --dry-run
```

I haven't run it. I didn't check what `--dry-run` actually skips, because the script only prints the bucket and the flag value in the lines I saw. Before relying on it, confirm that the rest of the script honors the flag and doesn't write anything.

If you want a real (non-dry) export test, point `EXPORT_BUCKET` at a separate test bucket first. The script defaults to `ledgerline-exports-dev` when the variable is unset.
